sources.title: Netflix Offers Subscribers the Option of Instantly Watching Movies on Their PCs
supports: Netflix introduced instant watching in a phased six-month rollout
The launch initially targeted personal computers
The service was added for subscribers rather than replacing DVDs immediately

sources.title: Netflix 2007 Form 10-K
sources.author_or_institution: Netflix / U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission
supports: Instant watching had been added to unlimited plans
Content licensing and exclusivity constrained streaming

sources.title: Netflix 2010 Form 10-K
sources.author_or_institution: Netflix / U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission
supports: By the end of 2010 Netflix described itself as an Internet subscription streaming service
Streaming depended on licensed content, cloud services, and connected devices

sources.title: Binary choice reconstruction note
supports: Invest now versus wait is an editorial compression of a phased investment decision, not a documented two-card executive vote
